an6.19:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Nādike viharati Giñjakāvasathe.
an6.19:1.4: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an6.19:1.6: Maraṇasati bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā.
an6.19:1.7: Bhāvetha no tumhe bhikkhave maraṇasatin ti. 3.
an6.19:2.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.19:2.3: Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin ti?
an6.19:2.5: "aho vatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā" ti,
an6.19:2.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti. 4.
an6.19:3.1: Aññataro pi kho bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.19:3.2: ‘aham pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.
an6.19:3.3: Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin ti?
an6.19:3.5: "aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā" ti,
an6.19:3.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti. 5.
an6.19:4.1: Aññataro pi kho bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.19:4.2: ‘aham pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.
an6.19:4.3: Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin ti?
an6.19:4.5: "aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā" ti,
an6.19:4.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti. 6.
an6.19:5.1: Aññataro pi kho bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.19:5.2: ‘aham pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.
an6.19:5.3: Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin ti?
an6.19:5.5: "aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ cattāro pañca ālope saṃkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā" ti,
an6.19:5.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti. 7.
an6.19:6.1: Aññataro pi kho bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.19:6.2: ‘aham pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.
an6.19:6.3: Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin ti?
an6.19:6.5: "aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ ālopaṃ saṃkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā" ti,
an6.19:6.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti. 8.
an6.19:7.1: Aññataro pi kho bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.19:7.2: ‘aham pi kho bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti.
an6.19:7.3: Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu bhāvesi maraṇasatin ti?
an6.19:7.5: "aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ assasitvā vā passasāmi passasitvā vā assasāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā" ti,
an6.19:7.6: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhāvemi maraṇasatin' ti. 9.
an6.19:8.1: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā te bhikkhū etad avoca:--
an6.19:8.2: Yvāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an6.19:8.3: ‘aho vatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā' ti,
an6.19:9.1: yo cāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an6.19:9.2: ‘aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā' ti,
an6.19:10.1: yo cāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an6.19:10.2: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā' ti,
an6.19:11.1: yo cāyaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāveti
an6.19:11.2: ‘aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ cattāro pañca ālope saṃkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, Bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā' ti;
an6.19:12.1: ime vuccanti bhikkhave bhikkhū: pamattā viharanti, dandhaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāya.

an6.19:16.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:-- 10.
an6.19:16.2: Appamattā viharissāma, tikkhaṃ maraṇasatiṃ bhāvessāma āsavānaṃ khayāyā ti. Evaṃ
